# PowerMenuConfig

> **File:** `config/PowerMenuConfig.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

Reader for the PowerMenu section. Named PowerMenuConfig because `PowerMenu` is the surface type.

### Properties

- `monitors` (readonly string): "general" | "primary" | "focused" | "all" (see General.screensFor)
- `actions` (readonly var): Session actions shown, in order
- `confirm` (readonly bool): Destructive actions ask for a second press
- `tileSize` (readonly int)
- `showHeader` (readonly bool)
- `showHint` (readonly bool)
- `showBackdrop` (readonly bool): Dim the screen behind it
- `backdrop` (readonly real): 0-1 opacity of the backdrop
